description: The CLI's development-certificate trust support now recognizes Firefox NSS certificate databases under XDG_CONFIG_HOME. The override is now exposed as standard Aspire configuration (`certificates.nssDbPaths`, including user-level `~/.aspire` settings) instead of a dedicated environment variable, and takes precedence over the existing `DOTNET_DEV_CERTS_NSSDB_PATHS` upstream environment variable.
name: Firefox NSS certificate support in the CLI
